title: Murine CD8 T Cell Transduction
author: Kristin Anderson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.smrec56

steps.title: Prepare and Seed PLAT-E Cells
steps.instruction: Prepare PLAT-E cells for transduction by trypsinization and seeding into new plates.

substeps.instruction: Gently remove PLAT-E media and rinse cells with 1x DPBS.
Remove PBS and add 0.05% Trypsin; trypsinize at 37C for 1-2 minutes or until cells lift off the plate with a gentle tap.
Dilute and inactivate trypsin with 10ml PLAT-E media.
Transfer cells to a conical tube and centrifuge at 369 xg for 4-5 minutes at 4C, then remove supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 10mL PLAT-E media and count cells.
Seed new 10 cm plates with 2.2e6 cells per plate in 10ml PLAT-E media.
Return plates to 37C incubator.

steps.title: Prepare DNA Transduction Mixture
steps.instruction: Prepare the DNA complex using EC Buffer, Enhancer, and Effectene in polypropylene tubes (one per plate).

substeps.instruction: Thaw DNA tubes.
Add 300 uL EC Buffer to a 5mL polypropylene tube.
Add 2ug DNA to the EC Buffer.
Add 16uL of Enhancer and vortex for 1 second.
Incubate for 5 min at Room Temp.
Add 60uL of Effectene and vortex for 10 seconds.
Incubate for 10 min at Room Temp.

steps.title: Transduce PLAT-E Cells
steps.instruction: Apply the DNA mixture to the PLAT-E cells and incubate overnight.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate media from PLAT-E plates and add 7mL of T cell media to each plate.
Add 3 mL of T cell media to each tube of Effectene mixture, mix by pipetting up and down, and add slowly (dropwise) to each PLAT-E plate.
Swirl gently to mix and return to 37C incubator overnight.

steps.title: Maintain PLAT-E Cells and Prepare T Cells
steps.instruction: Refresh PLAT-E media and isolate/activate T cells from donor spleens.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate media from PLAT-E plates and replace with 10.5 mL T cell media.
Place plates in the 32C incubator overnight.
Harvest T cells by smashing donor spleens through a 40um filter; rinse and transfer to a 15 or 50 mL tube.
Centrifuge T cells at 369xg for 4-5 minutes at 4C.
Aspirate media and lyse spleens with 2ml/spleen ACK Lysis buffer for 2 minutes.
Dilute ACK Buffer with an equal or greater volume of T cell media and centrifuge at 369 xg for 4-5 minutes at 4C.
Resuspend pellet in T cell media.
Add 1ug/ml of anti-CD3 and anti-CD28 (e.g., 20ul of Ab per 10 mL of splenocytes).
Add 50 IU/mL of IL-2 (e.g., 10ul of Ab per 10 mL splenocytes).
Transfer 10mL of splenocytes per T25 flask and place in 37C incubator overnight.

steps.title: Perform First Viral Transduction
steps.instruction: Infect activated T cells with the virus harvested from PLAT-E cells.

substeps.instruction: Transfer T cells into 50mL tubes (one tube per independent viral transduction).
Harvest virus from PLAT-E plates and filter through a 0.45um Nalgene Syringe Filter.
Add 10.5 mL T cell media per PLAT-E plate and return to 32C incubator overnight.
Resuspend T cells in the filtered viral supernatant.
Add IL-2 at 50 IU/mL and Polybrene at 5ug/mL.
Plate the T cell/virus mixture in 12 well plates (approximately 1.5-2 mL per well), balance plates by weight, and spin at 1000 xg for 90 minutes at 30C.
Place plates in 37C incubator overnight.

steps.title: Perform Second Viral Transduction
steps.instruction: Repeat the transduction process for a second round of infection.

substeps.instruction: Collect T cells from wells, combine similar wells into a 50 mL tube, and spin down at 1350 RPM for 4-5 min at 4C.
Harvest virus from PLAT-E plates and filter through a 0.45um Nalgene Syringe Filter.
Resuspend T cells in the filtered viral supernatant.
Add IL-2 at 50 IU/mL and Polybrene at 5ug/mL.
Plate the T cell/virus mixture in 12 well plates (~1.5-2.5 mL per well), balance plates by weight, and spin at 1000 xg for 90 minutes at 30C.
Place plates in 37C incubator overnight.

steps.title: Maintain and Screen Transduced T Cells
steps.instruction: Provide ongoing nutritional support and sample cells for screening.

substeps.instruction: If media changes from orange to yellow, add 1-2 mL of T cell media per well.
Add 50 IU/ml IL-2 per well.
Remove a small sample of cells for screening.
Continue adding media (as needed) and IL-2 (50 IU/ml) every 48 hours.
